simple.meaning: כּוּמָז (kûwmâz) is a Hebrew word meaning “a jewel (probably gold beads).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כּוּמָז (H3558) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 35:22, with occurrences in Exodus, Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כּוּמָז (H3558) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כּוּמָז (H3558) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כּוּמָז (kûwmâz) / H3558 is traced through Exodus 35:22, Numbers 31:50 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
